statements.label: Theorem 1 (main)
statements.restatement: For x in X with Pc(x) >= 0 and (Pc)_s = 0 for s in {3,5,7,8,10,12} (non-strict), Phi_{c(x)}(O) >= 0 for all O in O(4), hence U(4) by Thm 1.2. Non-eight-distinct spectra go to the collision theorems (App. B, one-circle).

statements.label: Lemma 2
statements.restatement: At an eight-distinct point with exactly the contacts T, H12 has a nonconstant germ in (Y,Z), so a counterexample can be moved to generic real (D,k,u,h) keeping strict support and negativity at fixed O.
